sources.title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
sources.quote_checked: Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately. | The Board of Directors appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair of the Board.

sources.title: Nvidia Breaks Revenue And Profit Records, And Will Keep Doing It
sources.quote_checked: Our momentum is real. Our demand is accelerating. Our supply is growing. | We've got this.

sources.title: Interview: Post-Earnings Insight With Nvidia CFO Colette Kress
sources.quote_checked: The biggest part of planning for this size of company is planning our capital to design more products. | I am always looking forward to make sure our planning is assuming the best. | We are not going to get this all done in two years. | Do we have all of our pieces in order?

sources.title: Meet Nvidia's billionaire interim CEO, Colette Kress
sources.quote_checked: I think honestly, throughout my career, I was just always fascinated by somebody else's role. | I just get excited about learning new things. | surround yourself with people that you can learn from. | We do not waste a day, we don't waste a dime.

sources.title: Trillion Dollar Woman
sources.quote_checked: One of the things we don't focus on is the stock price. | We focus on our investors and how we would like to innovate. | the 'supermarket test' | It is no bubble. | This is my fourth company in a 35-year career. I still can't believe it's been 10 years at Nvidia.
